# Feature: Voice design TTS via Voicebox instruct

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-07-13 -->

## Intent

Qwen ignores `design_prompt` on designed profiles at `/generate`. Scriptony must send the compiled candidate prompt as `instruct` so female/high/fairy voices actually render. Purge orphan `__preview-*` Voicebox profiles.

## Preconditions

- Desktop app, Voicebox sidecar running
- Character voice modal, Basic description filled (318-char English brief visible)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Voice design synthesis POST `/generate` includes non-empty `instruct` (full candidate prompt)
- [ ] Female design instruct produces different audio hash than default male Pazulu profile (live verify)
- [ ] UI shows Voicebox hint that Qwen needs instruct for designed voices
- [ ] Starting new design session purges all `__preview-*` profiles from Voicebox
- [ ] Modal close discards session and purges orphan preview profiles

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Regenerate candidate passes updated instruct with variation attempt
- [ ] instruct omitted for non-design TTS paths (warmup, line playback) unchanged

## Regression

- [ ] `npm run verify -- --frontend` PASS
- [ ] Existing voicebox-api generate tests pass with optional instruct

## Assumptions

- Voicebox OpenAPI `instruct` field is stable for `qwen_custom_voice`
- Max instruct length matches design_prompt limit (2000)

## Implementation Notes

- `generateVoiceboxSpeech` + `startVoiceboxGeneration`: optional `instruct` in POST `/generate`
- Voice design synthesis passes full candidate prompt as `instruct`; throws if empty
- `purgeOrphanVoiceDesignPreviewProfiles()` on new design session + after discard
- UI Alert in `VoiceDesignCandidateList` with `VOICEBOX_DESIGNED_INSTRUCT_HINT`
- Live hash verify (2026-07-13): without instruct == Pazulu male (`88f1f869…`); with female instruct == `5c8e68a4…` (different)
- Manually purged 36 orphan `__preview-*` profiles from Voicebox
- `npm run verify -- --frontend` PASS
